dog.description_text: Meet York! 🐾 York is a small male dog with an irresistibly cute face and a sweet personality. He loves being around people and enjoys having companionship. York has lived with other dogs, so he has experience sharing his home with canine siblings. Although he can be a little fearful at times, he is friendly and just needs some patience, reassurance, and love to help him feel safe and confident. With a caring home and a little time to settle in, York has the potential to become a wonderful and loving companion. ❤️
dog.name: York
